questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A body starts from rest and moves with constant acceleration. Which quantity changes uniformly with time?
questions.explanation: For constant acceleration, velocity changes uniformly with time.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: If the net force acting on an object is doubled while its mass remains constant, what happens to its acceleration?
questions.explanation: Newton's second law gives F = ma. With constant mass, doubling force doubles acceleration.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: If the speed of an object is doubled, its kinetic energy becomes:
questions.explanation: Kinetic energy is proportional to the square of speed: K = 1/2 mv².
